summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the two new features on the preview URL (mobile 390x844). Bake-Along (Learn/Impara tab): card renders theme title/description/tip/participants + leaderboard; guest gating opens auth modal; amico1 joined (note textarea -> JPEG upload via file chooser) -> entry published, 'already entered' banner shown, entry visible in leaderboard with author name 'Amico Uno', rank-1 crown and note (auto-translated to EN); amico2 voted -> like count 0->1, heart filled, persisted after reload. PDF multi-recipe import (admin -> Your Lab -> Le Mie Ricette -> Upload from PC): 2-page reportlab PDF (Pane Rustico / Focaccia) -> POST /api/maestro/scan-recipe-pdf 200 -> pdf-recipes-list with 2 rows, both thumbnails rendered (data:image/jpeg base64, naturalWidth=298) with 'Page 1'/'Page 2' labels, toast 'Found 2 recipes in the PDF'; 'Save all (2)' -> 2x POST /api/recipes 200 and both rows show 'Saved'; clicking pdf-recipe-0 opens RecipeDialog pre-filled (name 'Pane Rustico', flour 'tipo 1', preferment prefilled). All requested flows PASS.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testid 'capo-quicklink-aggiungi' on 2 elements (quicklinks button + tools-cat-impasto tile) -> Playwright strict-mode violation; testids must be unique
EN/ES/DE pluralization: shows '1 participants' (should be '1 participant'); no singular handling in tri() string

issues: 'Origin (flag)', 'Dough type', 'Preferment type' use native browser <select> elements instead of the shadcn Select component - inconsistent with the rest of the UI (pre-existing, not part of new features)
4x console 401 errors on first load (unauthenticated calls, e.g. /api/auth/me and gated endpoints) - noisy but non-blocking

action_items: Make 'capo-quicklink-aggiungi' testid unique (e.g. capo-quicklink-aggiungi vs tools-tile-aggiungi)
Fix singular/plural for participants count in BakeAlong
Optional: silence expected 401s for guests on initial load
critical_code_review_comments: BakeAlong.vote(): optimistic update then bakeAlongApi.like(id) with catch->load(); on failure a toast should also be shown, otherwise the user sees a silent revert
BakeAlong: if (!data) return null - a fetch failure renders nothing with no error/loading state (no retry UI)
ScanRecipe: pdf-recipes-list only renders when pdfRecipes.length > 1; a PDF with exactly 1 recipe goes straight to the dialog (works, but no thumbnail preview path)
